testCase:
R-34: Browse a user homepage that reposted the top song from the Top 50 Rock chart.
Goal: Browse a user homepage that reposted the top song from the Top 50 Rock chart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-34/
STEP 2: Hover over "Discover"
STEP 3: Click "Charts"
STEP 4: Choose "Rock" in "Genre" (with "Top 50" selected)
STEP 5: Click the first track, "Glass Harbour"
STEP 6: Click "Reposts"
STEP 7: Click "ember_riff"
STEP 8: Verify "who reposted" is visible

plan.title: R-34: Browse a rock chart reposter

steps.note: Confirm the Top 50 chart is selected.
View users who reposted the track.
Verify the requested destination text is visible.

reasoning: This test follows the top Top 50 Rock track to the homepage of a user who reposted it. The plan checks that Top 50 is selected and asserts the requested destination text after following the repost link.
